identification.description: Strongly aromatic annual herb with erect branched stems and palmately divided leaves.
identification_points: Leaves are palmately compound with narrow serrated leaflets.
Female plants bear dense flowering clusters.
Fruits are small achenes enclosed by persistent bracts.
